description: In every PA-model, the finite-history recursion graph of arbitrary arithmetic base and step formulas satisfies the stated zero and successor equations.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.recursion_equations_model.{u} {n : ℕ}
  (base : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin n ⊕ Unit))
  (step : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin (n + 2) ⊕ Unit)) {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (x : Fin n → M) (k y : M) :
  ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursionGraph
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph base step).Realize
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend
          (Fin.snoc x (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M)) y) ↔
      base.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x y)) ∧
    ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursionGraph
            Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph base step).Realize
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend
          (Fin.snoc x (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M k)) y) ↔
      ∃ a,
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.recursionGraph
                Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.betaGraph base step).Realize
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend (Fin.snoc x k) a) ∧
          step.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend (Fin.snoc (Fin.snoc x k) a) y))
